Основные обязанности - Администрирование серверов под управлением Linux и обеспечение бесперебойной работы серверной инфраструктуры. - Установка, настройка и сопровождение почтовых серверов на базе Postfix, Dovecot и сопутствующих сервисов. - Настройка и поддержка почтовых протоколов SMTP, IMAP и POP3. - Настройка интеграции Postfix и Dovecot с базами данных и системами аутентификации пользователей. - Обеспечение стабильной работы корпоративной электронной почты и поддержка почтовых клиентов, включая Microsoft Outlook. - Настройка DNS-записей для почтовых доменов, включая MX, SPF, DKIM и DMARC. - Настройка и сопровождение TLS/SSL-сертификатов для защиты почтовых соединений. - Обеспечение безопасности почтовой инфраструктуры, защита от спама, вредоносных вложений и несанкционированного доступа. - Мониторинг почтовых очередей, анализ системных журналов и устранение проблем с доставкой электронной почты. - Настройка и сопровождение почтовых фильтров и средств антивирусной защиты электронной почты. - Администрирование сетевых сервисов, включая DNS, DHCP, VPN и TCP/IP. - Мониторинг производительности серверов, диагностика и устранение технических неисправностей. - Организация резервного копирования и восстановление данных. - Обеспечение информационной безопасности, установка обновлений и устранение уязвимостей. - Ведение технической документации и оказание технической поддержки пользователям. Требования к кандидату - Высшее или среднее профессиональное образование в области информационных технологий. - Практический опыт администрирования серверов под управлением Linux. - Знание принципов работы и практические навыки настройки Postfix и Dovecot. - Знание почтовых протоколов SMTP, IMAP и POP3. - Опыт настройки SPF, DKIM и DMARC, понимание принципов аутентификации отправителей электронной почты. - Знание DNS, MX-записей, обратного DNS (PTR), TCP/IP и TLS/SSL. - Навыки работы с командной строкой Linux, системными службами, журналами и инструментами сетевой диагностики. - Опыт диагностики проблем с доставкой электронной почты, SMTP-аутентификацией и подключением почтовых клиентов. - Понимание принципов защиты почтовых серверов от спама и несанкционированного доступа. - Знание принципов резервного копирования, мониторинга и обеспечения безопасности серверной инфраструктуры. - Ответственность, внимательность, аналитическое мышление и способность оперативно решать технические задачи. Дополнительные преимущества - Опыт работы с PostfixAdmin, Rspamd, SpamAssassin, Amavis и ClamAV. - Знание Nginx или Apache и навыки написания Bash-скриптов для автоматизации административных задач. - Опыт сопровождения почтовой инфраструктуры для нескольких доменов. - Навыки работы с системами виртуализации и мониторинга серверов. - Опыт настройки и устранения проблем с Microsoft Outlook, включая Autodiscover и подключение к почтовым серверам. Условия работы - Работа в ООО «Авиакомпания Сомон Эйр». - Возможность профессионального развития и повышения квалификации. - Работа в команде специалистов Департамента информационных технологий. Порядок подачи документов Заинтересованным кандидатам необходимо направить резюме (CV) на один из следующих адресов электронной почты: - amirkhoni.nosir@somonair.com - hr@somonair.com В теме письма необходимо указать: «Системный администратор Linux». Кандидатам рекомендуется указать в резюме информацию об образовании, профессиональном опыте, технических навыках и опыте работы с Linux, Postfix и Dovecot.

review_candidates.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
review_candidates.description: Senior DevOps Engineer (DevOps ) What Makes Us, Us Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp! At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. If you like what we're saying, keep reading! WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our SaaS Onboarding & Reliability team at SimCorp. This role is pivotal in ensuring the seamless delivery, integration, and reliability of our cloud-based solutions. As part of a cross-functional agile team, you will combine your expertise in software development and IT operations to enhance deployment pipelines, automate infrastructure, and maintain high service availability. You will play both DevOps and SRE roles — building and automating our Azure platform while keeping mission-critical client environments reliable and secure. You will contribute to the onboarding of new clients onto our GAIN SaaS offering and play a key part in our strategic migration of live clients from AWS to Azure. You will promote continuous improvement through feedback, monitoring, and collaboration with peers and stakeholders. What You Will Be Responsible For DevOps & Engineering Administer and support SimCorp Data Management and Cloud SaaS (GAIN) environments for internal and external clients. Build and manage cloud environments using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, ARM). Develop and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines to automate builds, deployments, and integrations. Create and enhance automation scripts (PowerShell, Python, etc.) to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort. Streamline release and deployment processes for faster, more reliable delivery. Apply OS, database, and infrastructure patches in line with current standards. Conduct Proof of Concepts (PoCs) with Cloud Services Architects to evaluate new solutions. Contribute to the migration of live clients - building and adapting the infrastructure and pipelines required to stand up client environments on Azure. Monitoring, Reliability & Incident Management (SRE) Implement monitoring and alerting solutions for Azure services and infrastructure. Manage incidents, problems, and changes in alignment with SRE and ITIL best practices. Investigate and resolve complex technical issues, performing root cause analysis and implementing sustainable fixes. Schedule, optimise, and transition batch jobs to event-driven patterns using enterprise schedulers (e.g. ActiveBatch). Participate in disaster recovery and business continuity exercises, including annual VAPT. Provide weekend or on-call support on a rotational basis. Security & Compliance Apply secure-by-design and DevSecOps principles across identity, access, networking, and configuration controls. Ensure compliance with SOC2 and other regulatory requirements by producing operational metrics and reports. Maintain strong security and high availability across all environments. Collaboration & Communication Work closely with development, operations, and Professional Services teams to ensure smooth integration and delivery, including support for product upgrades. Engage directly with clients to resolve technical issues and improve service quality. Maintain clear documentation of processes, configurations, and procedures. Mentor and share knowledge with junior engineers to support team development. Actively participate in Scrum events — planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives. What We're Looking For 7+ years of relevant experience in DevOps & Site Reliability Engineering. Extensive experience with Azure services, Azure DevOps pipelines, and automation tools. Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, or similar). Proficiency in scripting languages such as PowerShell or Python. Solid understanding of monitoring, alerting, and incident management. Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks (e.g. SOC2). Proficient problem-solving skills and the ability to work in agile, cross-functional teams. Strong communication and client-facing skills. Your Qualifications Bachelor's degree in computer science or engineering. 7+ years' experience managing cloud platform in the financial sector. Demonstrated experience with Azure DevOps and Azure services, including Active Directory, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Sentinel, Key Vault, Citrix, Oracle Container & PDB, Functions, Monitoring, Insights, and Billing. Extensive Windows and Linux server administration skills, along with Oracle administration, PL/SQL, XML, and virtualization (VMware, Citrix). Proficiency in Azure pipelines, PowerShell, Python, AWS Lambda, and Azure scripting. Experience with infrastructure creation and application deployment using Terraform and Ansible. Skilled in developing CI/CD pipelines and associated tooling. Knowledge of IT systems administration, IT security operations, and financial data management (reference data, portfolio pricing, corporate actions). Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Grafana. ITIL and ITOps experience in an agile environment. Effective communication, teamwork, presentation, and listening skills. Skilled analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive and results-driven mindset. Familiarity with SimCorp Dimension is a strong plus. What We Value The expectations of a software engineer's behavioural skills are centred around a collaborative mindset of working in teams. Business knowledge requirements vary across Product Development but are overall within the financial sector. At SimCorp we use several coding languages and technical domains, so the concrete skills here also vary across the organization. Benefits Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. SimCorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days. SimCorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just one route — we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. NEXT STEPS Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible; we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. For any questions you are welcome to contact Swati Pal (Swati.pal@simcorp.com) , Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. Who We Are For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Ben jij een Cloud Engineer die wil werken aan bedrijfskritische systemen met maatschappelijke impact? Bij CGI zoeken we een professional die wil bijdragen aan het ontwerpen, bouwen en beheren van moderne IT-platformen binnen de sector Rail & Public Transport. Waar kom je terecht? CGI Rail, gevestigd in Rotterdam, werkt aan de transformatie van railsystemen die essentieel zijn voor de besturing van het Nederlandse spoorwegnet. Je komt te werken in onze hechte RailInfra Unit binnen de sector Rail & Public Transport. Hier werk je aan het vernieuwen van bestaande IT-systemen en het ontwikkelen van nieuwe platformen die cruciaal zijn voor de veiligheid, betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van het spoor. Onze systemen ondersteunen onder andere de aansturing van seinen en wissels, leveren realtime informatie aan treindienstleiders en vormen de basis voor simulatie- en opleidingssystemen. Binnen CGI Public Transport werken ongeveer 250 professionals aan innovatieve oplossingen om mobiliteit te verbeteren, capaciteit te vergroten en het spoor toekomstbestendig te maken. Wat breng je mee? HBO- of WO-opleiding in Informatica of een vergelijkbare richting Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als Cloud Engineer, DevOps Engineer of vergelijkbare rol. Ervaring met cloudplatforms zoals Azure, AWS of GCP. Kennis van CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code en automatisering. Aantoonbare ervaring met Kubernetes en containertechnologie (Docker). Ervaring met hybride omgevingen (combinatie van on-prem datacenter en cloud). Ervaring met virtualisatieplatformen, bij voorkeur VMware vSphere/ESXi/vCenter en/of Microsoft Hyper-V. Ervaring met Linux-omgevingen en scripting. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een proactieve houding. Ervaring met werken in Agile/Scrum-teams. Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal. Een pre-employment screening maakt onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure Waarom CGI CGI is één van 's werelds grootste IT-consultancy bedrijven. Onze mensen houden Nederland draaiende. Overheidsinstellingen, banken, lucht- en ruimtevaart, infrastructurele organisaties en energie- en productiebedrijven zijn klanten van CGI. We werken aan interessante projecten die het alledaagse leven van miljoenen mensen raken. We zijn regionaal aanwezig, versterkt met wereldwijde domeinkennis, ons ecosysteem en collega's verspreid over de hele wereld. We zijn trots op de impactvolle projecten die we samen met onze collega’s tot een succes maken. Bij CGI hechten we veel waarde aan diversiteit en inclusie, omdat dit niet alleen de samenwerking bevordert, maar ook vaak leidt tot betere resultaten. We kijken uit naar jouw bijdrage aan ons team! Daarnaast vinden wij het belangrijk dat iedereen bij ons zich eigenaar van hun eigen werk voelt. Letterlijk eigenaar, want bij CGI krijg je de mogelijkheid om aandeelhouder te worden en zo mee te delen in onze successen. Verder vinden wij het belangrijk dat jij geïnspireerd blijft, de dingen doet waar jij warm voor loopt en je kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Via onze CGI Academy kun je allerlei relevante trainingen volgen. Wat we nog meer te bieden hebben: een plek in een hecht team van professionals waar we samen met elkaar de verantwoordelijkheid voor de ontwikkeling van onze klanten en medewerkers dragen. Een team waarmee we klantverwachtingen kunnen overtreffen en ons binnen en buiten CGI op de kaart kunnen zetten. Een rol in ons CGI-verhaal! Vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure? Neem contact op met Recruitment Business Partner Natrah Pula via 06 112 187 23 of via Natrah.pula@cgi.com. Wij werken niet samen met externe recruitment-partijen. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van onze vacatures wordt daarom niet op prijs gesteld! Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Criteria Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action. In 1976 opgericht als een familiebedrijf, is CGI vandaag de dag een van de grootste onafhankelijke zakelijke en ICT-dienstverleners ter wereld. Bij ons draait het om ownership, teamwork en respect. Je krijgt de ruimte om al je talenten volledig te ontplooien. Vanaf je eerste werkdag ben je mede-eigenaar van CGI. We profiteren samen van ons succes en je krijgt de kans én verantwoordelijkheid om actief bij te dragen aan de koers en strategie van ons bedrijf. Jouw inzet voegt waarde toe. Je werkt aan innovatieve oplossingen en bouwt aan je netwerk van collega's en klanten. Je hebt toegang tot wereldwijde kansen om je ideeën te realiseren, mogelijkheden te benutten en te profiteren van onze kennis van de industrie en technologische expertise. Ontdek bij ons de mogelijkheden voor jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling en zet de volgende stap in je carrière. Hier staat jouw succes centraal!
